identificationModule.briefTitle: Dabrafenib With Trametinib in the Adjuvant Treatment of High-risk BRAF V600 Mutation-positive Melanoma (COMBI-AD).
identificationModule.officialTitle: COMBI-AD: A Phase III Randomized Double Blind Study of Dabrafenib (GSK2118436) in COMBInation With Trametinib (GSK1120212) Versus Two Placebos in the ADjuvant Treatment of High-risk BRAF V600 Mutation-positive Melanoma After Surgical Resection

armGroups.label: Dabrafenib and trametinib
armGroups.description: Subjects received dabrafenib (150 mg twice daily) and trametinib (2 mg once daily) orally for 12 months.

armGroups.label: Dabrafenib and trametinib placebos
armGroups.description: Subjects received matching placebos orally for 12 months

interventions.name: Dabrafenib
interventions.description: Each capsule contained 50 mg or 75 mg of free base (present as the mesylate salt)

interventions.name: Trametinib
interventions.description: Each tablet contained 0.5 mg or 2.0 mg of trametinib parent (present as the DMSO solvate)

interventions.name: Placebos
interventions.description: The placebo capsules and tablets contained the same inactive ingredients and film coatings as the dabrafenib and trametinib study treatment
